title: SPACE: Source-free Proxy Anchor Concept Erasure for MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.09868v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face growing privacy risks and regulatory constraints, machine unlearning (MU) has emerged as a crucial solution for removing sensitive data while preserving model performance. However, existing MU methods typically rely on visual data of the target concepts, which is often unavailable due to strict data retention policies, thus creating a demand for source-free unlearning approaches that operate without access to the target data. In this work, we propose Source-free Proxy Anchor Concept Erasure (SPACE), the first source-free unlearning framework specialized for MLLMs. SPACE consists of two stages: (1) Text-Guided Proxy Anchor Selection (TPAS), which retrieves semantically aligned proxy anchors from the shared feature space. (2) Dual-Constraint Semantic Isolation (DCSI), which optimizes these anchors to indirectly erase target concepts. DCSI confines updates to the null space of retai

translated_title: SPACE：面向多模态大语言模型的无源代理锚点概念擦除方法
translated_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）面临日益增长的隐私风险和监管限制，机器遗忘已成为在保持模型性能的同时删除敏感数据的关键解决方案。然而，现有的机器遗忘方法通常依赖于目标概念的视觉数据，而由于严格的数据保留政策，这些数据往往无法获取，因此催生了对无需访问目标数据的无源遗忘方法的需求。在本工作中，我们提出了无源代理锚点概念擦除，这是首个专门面向多模态大语言模型的无源遗忘框架。SPACE 包含两个阶段：（1）文本引导的代理锚点选择（TPAS），从共享特征空间中检索语义对齐的代理锚点；（2）双约束语义隔离（DCSI），通过优化这些锚点来间接擦除目标概念。DCSI 将更新约束在保留……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SPACE 提出了首个面向多模态大语言模型的无源机器遗忘框架，通过文本引导的代理锚点选择和双约束语义隔离两个阶段，在无需访问目标概念原始数据的情况下实现敏感概念的擦除。
en_tdlr: SPACE is the first source-free unlearning framework for MLLMs, which erases target concepts without accessing their original data through two stages: Text-Guided Proxy Anchor Selection and Dual-Constraint Semantic Isolation.
